about: The falsifier: at epoch 301 the receipts region printed @1 as two lines per region, a digest line and a count line, both at the digest of the @8 bytes, where audit/wire/receipts (owner, epoch 296) rules one line per region: region, count, digest of its set. A second head that reads a line per region reads every region twice, and a line at the digest of the whole set moves when any region does.

cases.name: the fixture @1 with the body of epoch 301
